items.title: Eritrea urges UN deterrence measures against Ethiopia
items.description: Eritrea has officially requested UN Security Council assistance over the conflict in Tigray. Both Eritrea and Ethiopia accuse each other of fueling regional instability.

items.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people
items.description: Volodymyr Zelensky says the attack, which left children dead, was Russia expressing its "thanks" for a US diesel deal.
